provenance: Original independent assessments created for this study curriculum; NOT 01Edu official subjects, audits, grading or unlock requirements.

go.title: Reproducible shell and Git workspace
go.deliverable: Create a Go module and shell script that prints repository metadata without changing tracked files.
verification_checks: Git diff shows only intended files
go.submission_evidence: Record stdout and exit codes; submit a clean Git commit.

go.title: Rune-based command-line banner
go.deliverable: Write a Go program that prints alphabet patterns and counts Unicode runes from arguments.
verification_checks: Unicode rune count differs correctly from byte length
go.submission_evidence: Run go test ./... with table-driven Unicode cases.

go.title: Integer algorithms with edge cases
go.deliverable: Implement factorial, prime checking, next-prime and integer square root as independent functions.
go.submission_evidence: Explain O(n) versus O(sqrt n) divisibility checks.

go.title: Unicode string utilities and CLI arguments
go.deliverable: Implement capitalization, reverse-runes, and a CLI flag for uppercase output.
go.submission_evidence: Compare rune and byte indexing tradeoffs.

go.title: Validated number-base converter
go.deliverable: Convert signed integers to and from a custom base and reject invalid alphabets.
verification_checks: Reject duplicate digits and length under two

go.title: Streaming file filter with callback
go.deliverable: Implement a line-oriented file processor that accepts a predicate and sorts accepted records.
go.submission_evidence: Document memory complexity and failure handling.

go.title: Linked-list operations with invariants
go.deliverable: Implement push-front, push-back, reverse, delete and cycle detection for a singly linked list.
go.submission_evidence: Write invariant-focused tests and analyze O(n) traversal.

go.title: Binary search tree and CLI integration
go.deliverable: Build an integer BST with insert, search, in-order traversal and CLI query mode.
verification_checks: no recursion overflow on provided stress set.
go.submission_evidence: Provide architecture note and benchmarks for sorted vs random inserts.

rust.title: Typed arithmetic crate
rust.deliverable: Implement numeric conversions and arithmetic functions with explicit integer and float types.
rust.submission_evidence: Explain integer widths and checked arithmetic.

rust.title: Text processing with ownership-aware returns
rust.deliverable: Implement case transforms, Fibonacci and a retrying stdin loop.
rust.submission_evidence: Use unit tests and explain owned String versus borrowed str.

rust.title: Borrowed substring toolkit
rust.deliverable: Implement prefix deletion, character count and in-place string editing with borrowed inputs.
rust.submission_evidence: Explain why returning a reference to a local temporary fails.

rust.title: Result and enum-driven validator
rust.deliverable: Implement structured records and a validator returning Result with a custom error enum.
verification_checks: tests for valid and invalid data.
rust.submission_evidence: Write an error contract and show ergonomic propagation with ?.

rust.title: HashMap analytics library
rust.deliverable: Build word-frequency analysis and an inventory update API using Vec, HashMap and iterators.
rust.submission_evidence: Analyze expected HashMap complexity and ownership.

rust.title: Generic trait-based transformations
rust.deliverable: Create a trait-based formatter with generic input and a borrowed reference implementation.
rust.submission_evidence: Explain trait versus inherent method and generic constraints.

rust.title: Matrix algorithms with type safety
rust.deliverable: Implement matrix transpose, multiplication and dot product with dimension validation.
rust.submission_evidence: Compare algorithmic complexity and checked indexing.

rust.title: Robust command-line data processor
rust.deliverable: Implement a CLI that reads structured records, aggregates results and reports errors.
rust.submission_evidence: Include integration tests, architecture diagram and performance notes.

javascript.title: Primitive and function contract
javascript.deliverable: Create a JS module with type predicates and basic arithmetic utilities.

javascript.title: Loop and date-boundary toolkit
javascript.deliverable: Implement FizzBuzz-like rules, string triangles and leap-year checks.
javascript.submission_evidence: Use parameterized tests for boundary dates.

javascript.title: Immutable object utilities
javascript.deliverable: Implement get, pick, omit, slice and array reverse without mutating inputs.

javascript.title: Closure and functional pipeline
javascript.deliverable: Implement a counter factory, function composition and map/filter without built-in equivalents.
javascript.submission_evidence: Explain lexical capture and referential transparency.

javascript.title: Promise retry and timeout library
javascript.deliverable: Implement retry, timeout, Promise.all-like aggregation and a cancellable timer.
javascript.submission_evidence: Use deterministic fake timers or controlled delays.

javascript.title: Accessible DOM interaction
javascript.deliverable: Build a keyboard-accessible filterable list with delegated events and visible status.
javascript.submission_evidence: Add browser automation smoke test and accessibility notes.

javascript.title: Algorithmic object and string engine
javascript.deliverable: Implement deep copy, recursive merge and unique integer partitions.
javascript.submission_evidence: Discuss cycles and state explicitly whether supported.

javascript.title: Fetch-driven searchable dashboard
javascript.deliverable: Build a paginated searchable sortable dashboard from JSON with loading and error states.
verification_checks: search and sort consistent across pages
javascript.submission_evidence: Write a small performance and accessibility review.
